introHtml: Corkcicle camping mugs combine triple-insulated stainless steel construction with the brand's signature style, keeping coffee hot for hours on the trail. Ideal for corporate retreats, outdoor trade shows, or employee appreciation gifts, these 16 oz mugs feature a splash-proof lid and ergonomic handle. Decorate with your logo using laser engraving or screen printing for a premium finish that stands up to rugged use.
